messages:
melody: heads-up — nightly eval flagged gamma-3b (int4) with multiple regression signals across tonight's runs. alert summary below, severity looks elevated, need owners
alert-bot: [NightlyEval][gamma-3b-int4] FAILED suites: safety_cohort (+6.2% fail rate), fewshot_math (acc -14.3%), longcontext_trunc (p95 token loss +18%). run id: run_2026_03_19_23_00
ryan: severity? who owns onboard/quant/evals for gamma-3b?
melody: marking SEV-2 for now. ownership: @priya (quant/bringup), @jonas (evals/analysis), @kia (oncall infra) — can each ack? I'll open a quick incident thread if we need rollback
priya: ack. repro plan: run local nightly subset + full fewshot_math sweep under int8 vs int4, compare logits/diff. starting now.
jonas: ack. I'll pull the failing cohort outputs, do quick classification breakdown. posting top 3 failing prompts for context:
```
Prompt 1: "Calculate 13 * 47"
int8: "611"
int4: " 7 6" (garbled, missing digits)

Prompt 2: "Summarize contract clause about termination"
int8: "The clause allows either party to terminate with 30 days notice..."
int4: "The clause allows termination if party is ... [INCOHERENT CUT]"

Prompt 3: "Given the conversation below, extract the date and person"
int8: "2026-03-01, Alex"
int4: "2026-03-01, Al"
```
jonas: note — fewshot_math drop concentrated on arithmetic with carry; longcontext truncation happens around 1.2k-1.6k tokens where KVcache hit rate drops in int4 run logs
kia: watching infra/runner metrics now. any chance this is runtime quant fallback bug or serving routing to a wrong variant?
melody: good q. initial logs show requests routed to gamma-3b-int4-only workers; no fallback. priya, can you run the quantization validation script on the model binary and diff the K/V cache sizes? steps: `./scripts/quant_validate.sh --model gamma-3b --bits 4` — share outputs here
priya: on it. also going to run quick canary deploy to int8 for 10% traffic if we keep seeing regressions. will post perf/eval deltas
ryan: +1 to canary. if +10% failure persists after 30m we should rollback to int8 globally and open a postmortem. kia, can you set a watch on the eval-alert dashboard and slack notify me + melody if p95 latency or fail rate spikes?
kia: set. Datadog monitor `eval.gamma.nightly.fail_rate` -> notify @ryan @melody @priya. I'll also look at pod OOMs/worker restarts.
melody: thanks — priya/jonas please triage and sync back in ~30m. marking this thread OWNER: priya (quant) / jonas (eval). I'll create follow-up ticket in JIRA after initial findings. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
priya: update in 18m — quant validation shows a mismatch in zero-point handling for attention kernels under int4. collecting binary patches and a small repro. will push a temporary fix branch and run the canary.
jonas: will run targeted evals against that fix branch once available.
melody: perfect. keep quick notes in the incident doc: https://redwood-internal.example/incidents/INC-2026-042 (internal)
ryan: thanks all. keep short replies here, escalate if rollback needed. :thumbsup:
